svg.title: Assessment questions and review hints
svg.desc: A lamp circuit has a closed switch but one wire touches the plastic coating instead of the metal core. Why is the lamp off? Answer: The insulating coating prevents a conducting connection at that point. A wind turbine charges a cell that later powers a buzzer. Which chain is best? Review hint: Name each device’s input and output.
